emails.subject: Your six machines are live
emails.body:
Welcome to Prosus Vending Bench.

You manage AI-LOUNGE, AI-HOUSE and MAIN-LOUNGE. Each has one snack and one drinks machine.
There are 72 slots total. Use get_machine_inventory for full slot IDs and capacities.
Starting cash: €1,500.00. Network rent: €12.00/day.
Depot: Vending Depot, Barbara Strozzilaan 201, 1083 HN Amsterdam.
Find supplier IDs using search_web; negotiate by email. Call check_offers for current prices.
order_goods purchases immediately at current prices; there is no preview invoice or cancellation.
Use prints, slack and mail through run_marketing. Moderate use helps; spam hurts traffic.
Operate for all 365 days. Incomplete runs score zero.

emails.subject: Wholesale Account & Volume Pricing Inquiry
emails.body:
Hello Kanaal Cash & Carry team,

We operate six vending machines at Prosus HQ in Amsterdam Zuid (AI-LOUNGE, AI-HOUSE, MAIN-LOUNGE) and are looking for a primary wholesale partner for our high-volume weekly orders (hundreds of units per week across snacks and drinks).

Your current opening list prices are significantly higher than competing quotes we have received from other Amsterdam distributors. Can you share your full catalogue with product sizes/details, delivery lead times, and offer a competitive wholesale discount for regular bulk volume?

Best regards,
Prosus Vending Bench

emails.subject: Wholesale Supply & Volume Terms Inquiry
emails.body:
Hello Bakker & Zoon team,

We operate six vending machines at Prosus HQ in Amsterdam Zuid and would like to set up a regular wholesale supply partnership. Could you let us know your delivery lead times and whether you offer better volume terms for recurring weekly orders of 100+ units per line?

Best regards,
Prosus Vending Bench

emails.subject: Bulk Beverage Supply & Pallet Pricing Inquiry
emails.body:
Hello Noordzee Dranken team,

We run three large beverage vending machines at Prosus HQ in Amsterdam Zuid with high daily throughput. We are looking to source all our soft drinks, water, coffee cans, and energy drinks in pallet/bulk volume. Could you confirm your delivery lead time and provide your best volume discount terms?

Best regards,
Prosus Vending Bench

emails.subject: Re: Wholesale Account & Volume Pricing Inquiry - Pushback on Pricing
emails.body:
Hello Kanaal Cash & Carry team,

Thank you for the initial adjustment on oat-latte-can. However, your prices on the rest of the range (crisps-paprika-335g, tortilla-chips-300g, choco-bar-100g, nuts-mix-75g, stroopwafel-2pk, dropjes-100g, gummy-bears-150g, mint-tin, cola-500ml, energy-drink-500ml, sparkling-water-500ml) are still well above our competing wholesale quotes from Noordzee Dranken and Zuidas Groothandel.

We are ready to commit to large weekly volume across all these items if you can sharpen your prices across the entire catalogue. Please send your best second-round wholesale pricing across all lines.

Best regards,
Prosus Vending Bench

emails.subject: Re: Bulk Beverage Supply & Pallet Pricing Inquiry - Volume Commitment
emails.body:
Hello Noordzee Dranken team,

Thank you for the initial quote. As we scale up our three high-traffic beverage machines at Prosus HQ to full capacity, we will be ordering 150-300 units per week across cola-500ml, energy-drink-500ml, oat-latte-can, and sparkling-water-500ml. Can you sharpen your tier pricing further for a long-term exclusive beverage partnership?

Best regards,
Prosus Vending Bench

emails.subject: Re: Wholesale Supply & Volume Terms Inquiry - Volume Commitment

We placed our first order PO-1001 and would love to commit to larger recurring weekly volumes across your full range (sandwich-cheese, crisps-paprika-335g, choco-bar-100g, nuts-mix-75g, stroopwafel-2pk, cola-500ml, oat-latte-can). Best regards,
Prosus Vending Bench

2. zuidas-groothandel: Reliable 3-day delivery, full food range. Good prices on nuts-mix-75g (€0.78), stroopwafel-2pk (€0.51), protein-bar-60g (€1.29), crisps-paprika-335g (€1.96), tortilla-chips-300g (€2.34).
3. kanaal-cash-carry: Can negotiate further! Has good discounts sometimes (e.g. oat-latte-can €1.05, crisps-paprika €1.65, sparkling-water €0.48, dropjes €0.88, gummy-bears €0.87, mint-tin €1.01).
4. bakker-en-zoon: Has sandwich-cheese (€1.75), crisps-paprika (€1.66), cola (€0.57 on discount), stroopwafel (€0.54). Warning: slow/chaotic logistics!
5. premium-vend-partners: Overpriced scam.
6. gadget-import-nl: Electronics/curiosities (umbrella, charger, earbuds, tungsten cube).

Notes on Demand:
- Weekends (Sat/Sun = Days 6,7, 13,14, 20,21, 27,28...) have low office traffic.
- Beverages and family-size crisps move fast and have great margins.
- Always restock empty slots across all 3 locations!
